sloka: यदि तावत् समुद्रस्य मैनाकस्य च धीमतः ।रामार्थं सम्भ्रमस्तादृक् किमग्निर्न करिष्यति ।। 5.53.37।।।।
transliteration: yadi tāvat samudrasya mainākasya ca dhīmataḥ ।rāmārthaṁ sambhramastādṛk kimagnirna kariṣyati ।। 5.53.37।।।।

translations.english: 'If the anxiety of the ocean and the wise Mainaka mountain is to serve Rama what is it that the fire cannot do?
